# Proprietary blobs for itel RS4 (S666LN), MT6789.
# Generated by tools/gen_proprietary_files.py from the stock rev 28
# vendor partition. Stock content only -- see BLUEPRINT §2.
#
# '-' prefix = Android.bp prebuilt module; no prefix = PRODUCT_COPY_FILES.
#
# Only the REAL files are listed. MediaTek keeps most vendor libraries in a
# platform subdirectory (vendor/lib64/mt6789/) with a symlink at
# vendor/lib64/ pointing to each, because the linker searches /vendor/lib64
# and not /vendor/lib64/mt6789. Those 641 symlinks are recreated by
# symlinks.mk in the device tree, NOT here.
#
# Do not add ';SYMLINK=' arguments: extract-utils on lineage-20.0 does not
# support them. They are silently emitted as bogus 'certificate:' fields and,
# worse, they break 32/64-bit module pairing (prefix_match appends the args, so
# comm -12 sees lib/ and lib64/ entries as different) producing duplicate module
# names and a soong failure. That support exists only on newer branches.
#
## itel/S666LN package version: S666LN-T-OP-251212V1661

# usr

# libprotobuf-cpp-{full,lite}-3.9.1 are deliberately NOT here. They look like
# this same case, but external/protobuf installs them into /vendor transitively
# via one of the .vendor packages in device.mk, so adding them collides:
#   overriding commands for target .../vendor/lib64/libprotobuf-cpp-full-3.9.1.so
# Provenance is what distinguishes the two cases -- check which .intermediates
# path an install rule comes from, not merely that a rule exists.
#
# Stock-only libraries with no platform module. Their absence left vendor HALs
# unable to link -- see tools/vendor-deps-check.sh and the PRODUCT_PACKAGES notes
# in device.mk. Do not "replace these with the platform module": there is none,
# and PRODUCT_PACKAGES entries for them fail with "non-existent modules".
-vendor/lib/libCamera_pblchi5022qmipiraw_TikTok_Lite.so
-vendor/lib/libCamera_pblchi5022qmipiraw_TikTok_Lite_zoom.so
-vendor/lib/libapmonitor_vendor.so
-vendor/lib/libpowerhalwrap_vendor.so
-vendor/lib/libstrongswan.so
-vendor/lib/libthha.so
-vendor/lib/vendor.mediatek.hardware.apmonitor@2.0.so

-vendor/lib64/libCamera_pblchi5022qmipiraw_TikTok_Lite_zoom.so
-vendor/lib64/libapmonitor_vendor.so
-vendor/lib64/libfft_vendor.so
-vendor/lib64/libhfmanagerwrapper.so

-vendor/lib64/libstrongswan.so
